allowed_scope: Retrospective closed-library identification/measurement-panel development using actual published measured records with exact provenance. Selection/replay of an energy channel is simulated acquisition, not a new physical experiment.
authentic_identity_limit: Reported structure/confidence metadata is source attribution, not new independent chemical authentication. Missing confidence fields do not alone prove unauthenticated identity.
builder_access_rule: After explicit classification as DEVELOPMENT the builder may inspect all released records; consumed records must not later be relabeled protected confirmation.
cohort_rule_required_before_outcomes: Full identity/formula definition fixed for beneficiary outcome, with stereochemistry handling explicit
Adduct, precursor, ionmode, exact instrument and fragmentation settings controlled
Comparable energy units explicitly represented; scaled/ramped protocols separate
Original record hashes and spectrum duplicates retained and disclosed
All admitted records/identities count, including failures and unresolved ambiguity
independence: Separate verifier metadata audit, shared model family/host/filesystem. Procedural separation, not external certification.
initial_grouping_limitations: Initial grouping used InChIKey connectivityblock, not full stereochemical identity
Precursor consistency and fragmentation/processing controls not included initially
Energy strings mix percentages, nominal units, NCE, scaled/ramped values and bare numbers; no blanket eV conversion is valid
next_evidence_needed: Original matched raw acquisitions or explicit injection/run/batch identifiers establishing library/query independence, plus a complete consequential assay contract and strongest qualified conventional route.
replicate_evidence_status: UNKNOWN; distinct accessions/peak hashes and MassBank record dates alone do not establish separate injections/acquisitions. Some inspected headers share author/date/reanalysis metadata. No claim that independent acquisitions do not exist.
